title: SearchSpaceTemplate
description: A named starting search space for a tuning session. Files live in schema/search-spaces/<name>.v<version>.yaml and are embedded in bench (servtuner spaces); New session offers the ones that fit the managed target, and the space stays editable. A change is a new version.

name.description: Lower-case words joined by hyphens; the file name starts with it.

title.description: A short label for a picker.

description.description: When to start from it, and what it searches.

fits.description: The managed targets it suits: their placement, and for Kubernetes their GPU count.

min_gpus.description: The fewest GPUs a Kubernetes target may request (0 for a CPU-only vLLM or the mock).

max_gpus.description: The most GPUs a Kubernetes target may request.
